commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' The referee allows time for a substitution. Kylian Mbappe will be replaced by Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid).
90+3' Corner kick. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is ready to send the ball into the box.
90+3' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+3' Real Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
89' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
89' The attendance is 72699.
87' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jan Virgili (Mallorca) replacing Manu Morlanes.
87' Substitution. Takuma Asano (Mallorca) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mateo Joseph walks off.
86' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
86' Real Madrid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
85' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
84' The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
83' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
81' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Madrid.
80' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Sanchez no option but to blow his whistle.
79' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Mateu Morey Bauza and he is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
79' The substitution is prepared. Johan Mojica (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Toni Lato.
77' The referee blows for a cooling break.
76' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) will deliver the corner kick.
75' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 10:2.
72' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Trent Alexander-Arnold.
72' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Vinicius Junior is replaced by Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Arda Guler walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid).
69' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the left side of the goal, but Thibaut Courtois is equal to it and makes an easy save.
68' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
67' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) replaces Franco Mastantuono.
66' Samu Costa (Mallorca) takes a good touch to control a cross on the edge of the box and fires a low shot towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block his effort.
65' It is time for a substitution. Samu Costa (Mallorca) is on for Pablo Torre.
63' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mallorca.
62' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
60' Celebrations are cut short for Real Madrid as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
58' The Real Madrid players halt their celebrations as referee Jose Sanchez makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
55' Goal! Arda Guler (Real Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 3:1.
54' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) tries to find Kylian Mbappe, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
52' Great teamplay by Real Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
52' Shots on target – 5:1.
50' Mallorca are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
48' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Mallorca show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.

45+4' The game is pretty dull as Real Madrid are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
45+4' Good work from Real Madrid as they win a corner.
45+3' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Leo Roman is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
45+2' The goal by Real Madrid won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
45+1' And it's a goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) slips the ball past the goalkeeper.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
43' Arda Guler plays a lovely pass into Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post.

42' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
41' A rebound falls kindly for Manu Morlanes (Mallorca), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
41' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

38' 2 - 1 Goal! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Leo Roman had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:1.
37' 1 - 1 Arda Guler (Real Madrid) scores with a header. Despite the ball going into the middle of the goal, the goalkeeper was unable to pull off a save.
37' Now Real Madrid have a corner.
34' The Real Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
34' A cooling break is underway.

32' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
31' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Leo Roman is equal to it and makes an easy save.
30' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to find Kylian Mbappe, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
29' Mallorca are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
29' 60:40 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
26' A long pass, executed by Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball is behind the touchline and Mallorca will take a throw-in.
26' Dangerous play by Arda Guler (Real Madrid). Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.

26' The move breaks down when Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
25' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pablo Torre (Mallorca). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
24' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is lurking on the edge of the box and receives a pass from Pablo Torre. He shows nice control before hitting a soft shot just wide of the left post.

24' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) with a great individual effort and low attempt from long range. The shot went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was prepared and managed to keep the ball out.
22' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle. Eder Militao (Real Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play.
21' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
18' 0 - 1 Pablo Torre takes the corner and Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the right side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
18' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
18' Toni Lato (Mallorca) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
16' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
15' Mallorca are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Leo Roman is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid). Easy save!
10' A crossfield pass from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates.
10' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
10' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
9' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Celebrations are cut short for Real Madrid as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
8' The Real Madrid players halt their celebrations as referee Jose Sanchez makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
7' Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is teed up on the edge of the box by Trent Alexander-Arnold, and his howitzer of a shot inside the right post gives the keeper no chance. 1:0.
4' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

4' A short pass finds Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
4' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
3' Real Madrid are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
1' Neat passing move from Mallorca in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
